grammar.title: Past Simple with Regular & Irregular Verbs
grammar.explain_en: We use the past simple to talk about completed actions in the past (like last summer). Regular verbs end in -ed, while irregular verbs change forms.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì quá khứ đơn để nói về hành động đã kết thúc trong quá khứ (như kỳ nghỉ hè năm ngoái). Động từ có quy tắc thêm -ed, động từ bất quy tắc biến đổi hình thức.
examples: I visited my grandparents last June.
We played beach volleyball yesterday.
They went to Phu Quoc by plane last month.
She bought cute souvenirs for her friends.
grammar.right: ✅ I went to Da Nang last summer.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I goed to Da Nang last summer.

grammar.title: Past Simple of BE: Was / Were
grammar.explain_en: Use 'was' with I, he, she, it, singular nouns. Use 'were' with you, we, they, plural nouns.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'was' với I, he, she, it và danh từ số ít. Dùng 'were' với you, we, they và danh từ số nhiều.
examples: The beach was very clean and quiet.
The seafood dishes were delicious.
My summer trip was fantastic.
We were happy during our vacation.

grammar.title: Future with WILL for Holiday Plans
grammar.explain_en: Use 'will + verb' to talk about plans or decisions for future holidays, like next summer.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'will + động từ nguyên thể' để nói về kế hoạch hoặc dự định cho kỳ nghỉ trong tương lai (ví dụ: mùa hè tới).
examples: Next summer, I will visit Ha Long Bay.
My family will stay in a nice resort.
We will try sea kayaking together.
They will buy funny gifts for everyone.
grammar.right: ✅ I will visit my cousins next year.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I will visiting my cousins next year.

grammar.title: Simple Comparatives: -er than
grammar.explain_en: When comparing two things, add -er to short adjectives and use 'than'.
grammar.explain_vi: Khi so sánh hai sự vật, thêm -er vào sau tính từ ngắn và dùng từ 'than'.
examples: The sea is warmer than the swimming pool.
This resort is bigger than our house.
Today is sunnier than yesterday.
My suitcase is heavier than your bag.
grammar.right: ✅ The hotel was bigger than my home.
grammar.wrong: ❌ The hotel was more big than my home.

readings.title: MY TRIP TO PHU QUOC ISLAND
readings.text: My name is Nam. I am nine years old. Last July, I went on a wonderful trip to Phu Quoc Island with my family. We travelled there by plane. The flight was fast and comfortable. We stayed in a beautiful resort near the beach. The weather was sunny and warm every day. In the morning, I built a high sandcastle with my younger sister, Mai. In the afternoon, we swam in the warm ocean water. In the evening, we ate fresh seafood at a night market. I bought a shell keychain as a souvenir. It was my favorite summer holiday!

readings.title: CAMPING IN THE MOUNTAINS
readings.text: Hello, I am Linh! Last June, my family did not go to the beach. We went camping in the cool mountains near Ba Vi. We packed two green backpacks, a yellow tent, and warm sleeping bags into our car. The trip took about two hours. When we arrived, the air was fresher and cooler than in the city. My brother Minh and I helped our dad put up the tent on green grass near a small stream. In the afternoon, we explored the forest, walked along shady paths, and took many photos with my camera. We could hear colorful birds singing in the high trees. At night, we built a small campfire, roasted sweet corn, and listened to dad's funny stories under the starry sky. It was a unique holiday because I learned how to set up a tent and protect nature.

readings.title: MEMORIES AND FUTURE PLANS
readings.text:
Every summer brings unforgettable memories for school children. Last year, my friend Ben from England visited Viet Nam during his summer break. He stayed with my family in Da Nang for ten sunny days. Together, we visited the famous Dragon Bridge and spent hours swimming in the ocean. Ben said that Da Nang beach was wider and cleaner than the beaches near his hometown. We also tried water slides at a huge waterpark and collected glossy red seashells along the shore. I gave Ben a silk lantern as a special gift, and he gave me a British postcard with a picture of Big Ben.

Next summer, my family will visit my grandparents in the countryside near Can Tho. We will travel by coach early in the morning. I am very excited because I will learn how to ride a bicycle through green fruit orchards. My brother plans to go fishing with our grandfather in a small wooden boat. We will stay there for two full weeks. Summer trips are wonderful because they allow us to relax, explore new places, and store warm memories with the people we love most.

life_skill.title: BE A SMART & RESPONSIBLE TRAVELER
life_skill.intro: Traveling is wonderful! When we visit new places, we should stay safe, protect nature, and respect local cultures.
life_skill.intro_vi: Đi du lịch thật là tuyệt vời! Khi đến những nơi mới, chúng ta nên giữ an toàn, bảo vệ thiên nhiên và tôn trọng văn hóa địa phương.
can_do: Always hold hands with parents in crowded tourist places.
Wear sunscreen and a wide hat when playing under bright sun.
Keep personal belongings inside a backpack or suitcase safely.
Throw trash and plastic bottles into designated litter bins.
Do not break coral reefs or take living animals from the sea.
Drink plenty of clean water during outdoor summer activities.
Say polite thank you words to local tour guides and hotel staff.
Wear a safe life jacket when riding a boat or swimming.
Keep hotel room clean and turn off air conditioners when leaving.
Take nice memories and leave only footprints on the sand.
Respect historic monuments and do not write on walls.
Help family members carry luggage cheerfully.
life_skill.value_question: What can you do to keep beaches and mountains clean when you travel?
life_skill.image_prompt: A happy group of children putting plastic bottles into a green recycling bin on a sunny beach.

fun_facts.en: Phu Quoc is the largest island in Viet Nam, famous for beautiful beaches and long cable car rides.
fun_facts.vi: Phú Quốc là hòn đảo lớn nhất Việt Nam, nổi tiếng với bãi biển đẹp và tuyến cáp treo dài.

fun_facts.en: Seashells are abandoned homes of small ocean mollusks like snails and clams.
fun_facts.vi: Vỏ sò, vỏ ốc là ngôi nhà cũ mà các loài thân mềm biển như ốc và ngao để lại.

fun_facts.en: The world's largest natural cave is Son Doong Cave located in Quang Binh Province, Viet Nam.
fun_facts.vi: Hang động tự nhiên lớn nhất thế giới là Hang Sơn Đoòng nằm ở tỉnh Quảng Bình, Việt Nam.

fun_facts.en: Airplanes burn special clean fuel that allows them to fly smoothly high above storm clouds.
fun_facts.vi: Máy bay dùng nhiên liệu sạch đặc biệt cho phép bay nhẹ nhàng trên cả các tầng mây bão.

fun_facts.en: Sunscreen works by absorbing or reflecting ultraviolet rays from the sun to protect human skin.
fun_facts.vi: Kem chống nắng hoạt động bằng cách hấp thụ hoặc phản xạ tia cực tím từ mặt trời để bảo vệ làn da.

classroom_game.name: SUMMER SUITCASE MEMORY CHAIN
classroom_game.players: Groups of 5–8 pupils or Whole Class
steps_en: Pupils sit in a circle. Teacher starts by saying: 'I packed my suitcase and I took sunscreen.'
The second pupil repeats the sentence and adds a new item: 'I packed my suitcase and I took sunscreen and a camera.'
Each pupil must repeat all previous travel items in exact order and add one new holiday word.
If a pupil forgets an item, they answer a warm-up question: 'Where did you go last summer?' before continuing.
The last student who remembers the longest memory chain wins a Roxy Sticker!
steps_vi: Học sinh ngồi thành vòng tròn. Giáo viên bắt đầu: 'I packed my suitcase and I took sunscreen.'
Học sinh thứ hai nhắc lại câu đó và thêm từ mới: 'I packed my suitcase and I took sunscreen and a camera.'
Mỗi học sinh nối tiếp phải lặp lại đúng thứ tự các từ trước và thêm một đồ dùng du lịch mới.
Nếu học sinh quên từ, em đó sẽ trả lời câu hỏi phụ: 'Where did you go last summer?' rồi tiếp tục.
Học sinh duy trì chuỗi trí nhớ dài nhất sẽ giành sticker khen thưởng từ Roxy!
